alice (sec-eng): heads-up: multiple tenants in ap-southeast returning SCIM 204 but RBAC changes not persisting. saw provisioner errors about missing KMS key id after last-night alias rotate.

ben (infra): can you paste one log line?

alice (sec-eng): snippet:
2026-08-14T03:12:01Z provisioner[pid=101]: ERROR apply-role tenant=orchid user=tim err="KMS:encrypt failed: key id missing" corr=tx-11a2
2026-08-14T03:12:01Z provisioner[pid=101]: INFO scim/patch -> 204

carla (sre): ops-bot, any rollout notes for ap-southeast?

ops-bot: KMS alias rotation job rot-20260814 completed in us-east/us-west; ap-southeast pending 3/5 hosts. Vault replication lag reported for ap-southeast shard.

ben (infra): likely bootstrap wrote alias but secret inject failed due to vault lag -> REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ID unset. plan: (1) collect /etc/rdw/kms_alias and kms_key_id on affected hosts, (2) emergency-inject key_id from primary to affected hosts, (3) restart bootstrap/provisioner, (4) gather evidence and run audit backfill for any missed role ops.

carla (sre): quick checks we ran:
# sudo cat /etc/rdw/kms_alias
# sudo cat /etc/rdw/kms_key_id || echo missing
# sudo journalctl -u rdw-bootstrap --since "2026-08-14 02:00" | tail -n 50

alice (sec-eng): confirmed alias present but kms_key_id empty on two hosts. uploading sanitized logs to /shared/sec-incidents/1967777777/.

ben (infra): remediated host ap-southeast-1b with emergency inject, restarted services. seeing KMS:encrypt success and queued deprov draining. patching runbook to add pre-check: verify secret presence across shard before completing alias rotation.

carla (sre): audit ingest dips recovered within 90s. creating alert for agent.kms_key_id_present==0 and audit.role_ops.drop > 10/min.

alice (sec-eng): opening PM/triage: root cause vault replication lag + bootstrap not fail-fast on missing secret. mitigations: rollout pre-check, bootstrap hard-fail, emergency-inject runbook, audit backfill procedure.

securitybot: Incident logged INC-20260814-4421 severity=medium status=mitigated
